citations.field: 病 entry; PDF p. 684, printed p. 671; scan /home/catalin/hanzi-etymology-books/research-ocr/ziyuan-full/page-0684/source.png
citations.text: Under headword 病 bìng, the book describes it as a phono-semantic graph, 从疒、丙声（或从方声）. It describes the original meaning as serious illness, cites Shuowen 疾加也 and Analects 子疾病, and lists later uses including illness, hardship, poverty, fatigue, defect, harm, worry, and resentment. The printed page number 671 is visible in the scan. The entry ends on this page; the following page begins with 疴 and contains no continuation of 病.

citations.field: 病 entry; PDF p. 684, printed p. 671; headword, graphic labels, formation and meaning discussion inspected; following PDF p. 685 checked for continuation
citations.text: The scan labels the entry 病 bìng and prints “形声字。从疒,丙声(或从方声)”; later it says “本义是重病” and quotes Shuowen “病,疾加也。从疒,丙声,” glossing 疾加 as illness worsening. It lists diagrams labeled Warring States, Shuowen small seal, Qin, Han and clerical. The entry ends on printed p. 671; p. 672 begins another entry, with no 病 continuation. The book therefore attributes both 丙 and 方 sound analyses, but the prose and labels do not establish which depicted occurrence supports 方. The printed page number and these text spans were read from the scan pixels. The OCR corpus text inspected matches the scan for the relevant passage; no correction is proposed.
